relationships.note: He identifies them himself: the storm, the black on the buildings and the plague are one thing, named here as the black death and placed in June 2028.
Both attach to the same tournament, one to the fixture list and one to a match that produced rioting.
He gives October 7th as the case in point: they prayed over it for months and it happened anyway, which is his own example of what prayer does not stop.
He names it a secret Pearl Harbor attack against Hawaii, joining the two claims in one phrase.
He states the consequence: if they do not maintain the House and the Senate, he is in trouble, and the Lord said it.
